summary: OpenAI provider chip color regression: tokens.tradition.buddhism changed green to orange in the rekey, now clashes with Anthropic amber
description: src/lib/provider-display.ts:55 sets OpenAI chip color = tokens.tradition.buddhism (comment 'muted green'). The tradition rekey (todo 719c7d45) changed buddhism from #5ac27a green to #d08a30 orange, so the OpenAI chip is now orange and collides with Anthropic's amber (tokens.tier.verified #c4a35a). Provider colors should not be coupled to the tradition palette. Fix: give PROVIDER_META its own explicit colors (or repoint openai to a green that won't drift). Add a guard test that provider colors are distinct.

resolution.note: Provider chip colors are explicit hexes, decoupled from tokens.tradition.
